text_block_list.text: I hear a familiar voice while on a<n>walk...
Somebody help me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!

I go running toward the source, only<n>to find Taiki
Shuttle in the school field<n>tugging at some vines.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Urk... Trainer! Help me out here!

The director asked me to harvest<n>these here
pumpkins!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's right! My hometown's<n>famous for our
pumpkin festival!

It's got stuff like a biggest pumpkin<n>contest and a
race where ya gotta lug<n>a pumpkin with you when
ya run!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention singin' and dancin'<n>under the stars!
It's real exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Once I heard the word "pumpkin,"<n>there was no
way I couldn't help!
choice_data_list: Time to put that experience to good use!
Time to put that experience to good use!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But now that I think about it... I've<n>never actually
harvested a pumpkin<n>before.
Even though I never missed a<n>festival... Haha.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What I'm tryin' to say is... ya gotta<n>help me out,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'll show you how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A competition? You mean...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You wanna see who can harvest 'em<n>the fastest?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That sounds awful fun! I got this in<n>the bag!

Racing to see who can harvest the<n>most pumpkins,
Taiki Shuttle and I<n>have a fun time clearing the
whole<n>field.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I end up helping Taiki Shuttle<n>with the
pumpkin harvesting.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, now it makes sense! You gotta<n>clear a gap so
ya can get on in there,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ya know, I just might be able to put<n>this to use
when I run too! Let's go<n>try it out in training!
choice_data_list: After we finish harvesting all these.

text_block_list.text: Oh, right...

We both get covered in mud<n>harvesting the
pumpkins, but at least<n>it seems she might have
learned<n>something.
